en.name: Urban Encounters (Levels 5—10)
en.caption: Urban Encounters (Levels 5—10)
rows: 1d6 {@creature swarm of bats||swarms of bats} and 1d6 {@creature swarm of rats||swarms of rats}
A talkative urchin, badgering passersby to serve as their guide through the community for a price of 1 sp
A {@creature noble} shouts "Stop! Thief!" at a fleeing scoundrel ({@creature bandit})
An actor leans out from a second-story window to call to passersby, announcing a show
A fortune-teller reads cards for those who pay a price of 1 sp

en.caption: Bard
rows: I awakened my latent bardic abilities through trial and error.
I was a gifted performer and attracted the attention of a master bard who schooled me in the old techniques.
I joined a loose society of scholars and orators to learn new techniques of performance and magic.
I felt a calling to recount the deeds of champions and heroes, to bring them alive in song and story.
I joined one of the great colleges to learn old lore, the secrets of magic, and the art of performance.
I picked up a musical instrument one day and instantly discovered that I could play it.

en.name: Coastal Encounters (Levels 5—10)
en.caption: Coastal Encounters (Levels 5—10)
rows: A {@creature pseudodragon} chasing gulls through the air
1 {@creature commoner} singing a dirge (day only) or 1 {@creature banshee} (night only)
A stoppered bottle containing an illegible note and half buried in the sand
A battle at sea between two galleons
A pirate crew consisting of 1 {@creature bandit captain}, 1 {@creature druid}, 2 {@creature berserker||berserkers}, and {@dice 2d12} {@creature bandit||bandits}, all searching for buried treasure
A severed humanoid hand tangled in a net
1 {@creature sahuagin baron} with {@dice 1d3} {@creature sahuagin priestess||sahuagin priestesses} and {@dice 2d8} {@creature sahuagin}
